aboutParagraphs: I am Logesh T, a Software Engineer L2 at Techcedence Infosystems Pvt. Ltd. (joined 22 January 2024 and currently employed), bringing over four years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack web, mobile, enterprise low-code platforms, healthcare workflows, warehouse operations, and EdTech.

At Techcedence Infosystems, I architected and delivered end-to-end features on TracAssets (physical/digital asset management with live BLE indoor floor-map tracking, GPS fleet geofencing, software license management, AMC maintenance, and six-stage asset transfers), built responsive healthcare interfaces on Ursamin using Next.js and RTK Query, developed reusable low-code modules on LCP and Pricing Calculator, engineered offline-first React Native stock auditing apps (Stock Take with Zebra SDK RFID and B&D Plumbers), and built the ISkreen digital identity badge and bag-tag platform.

Previously, I worked as a Software Engineer at IResponsive Solutions (Oct–Nov 2023) preparing requirements, cost analysis, and backend architecture templates for the TN School Mobile App, and at iamneo (Jul 2021–Oct 2023) where I delivered analytics, two-factor authentication, chat mentions, publisher modules, the NeoExamShield Chrome extension for exam integrity, and resolved 70 platform bugs across Neo Defenders.

Alongside my full-time engineering roles, I have independently delivered WordPress-based freelance websites including the London Tamil Sangam school/NGO portal and the Kongu Engineering College Alumni Website.
aiPositioningNote: I actively integrate AI-assisted development tools—including Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, and ChatGPT—into my engineering workflow for vibe coding, rapid UI/API prototyping, code generation, test scaffolding, and root-cause debugging. These tools accelerate my full-stack software delivery; they are presented honestly as developer productivity workflows rather than prior commercial AI/ML model-training employment.
